title: 받아쓰기 3: 받침 대표 소리
objective: Say the real sound of a final consonant and choose the right spelling when you hear [ㄱ], [ㄷ], or [ㅂ].
summary: Learn which sound a final consonant (batchim) makes, so you can write the right letter.

task.title: Hear, sort, and spell
task.line: Say each word aloud, think about its final sound, then write or choose the answer.

words.exampleMeaning: Let's meet in front of the school.

letters.as: Final ㅅ, ㅈ, ㅊ, ㅌ, ㅎ all sound like ㄷ: a short, stopped t.
Final ㄲ and ㅋ sound like ㄱ: a short, stopped k, like in 'book'.
Final ㅍ sounds like ㅂ: lips close, no puff of air, like 'cup'.

exercises: Write how each word sounds in [ ]: ① 밭 ② 숲 ③ 맛
Do the two words sound the same? Write Same or Different: ① 빗 / 빛 ② 입 / 잎 ③ 박 / 밭
You hear the sound in [ ]. Choose the right spelling: ① [바깓] 바깥 / 바깍 ② [끋] 끝 / 끅 ③ [무릅] 무릎 / 무릭
Which sound does the final consonant make: ㄱ, ㄷ, or ㅂ? ① 밑 ② 키읔 ③ 높다 (높)
answers: ① Same ([빋]) ② Same ([입]) ③ Different ([박] / [받])
① 바깥 ② 끝 ③ 무릎
① ㄷ ② ㄱ ③ ㅂ
